claim: Demo sample data stays separate from real practice data.
sandbox: An isolated database inserts a non-demo practice fixture, then proves demo read and mutation requests both return 404 and the fixture remains unchanged.

claim: Demo tokens use 256 random bits and sample workspaces expire after 24 hours.
sandbox: Generates and parses a token, decodes 32 random bytes, checks the exact 24-hour TTL, and rejects an expired token.

claim: Demo writes allow 12 immediate requests per first forwarded client IP, then return a retry time of at least one second.
sandbox: An isolated router sends 13 writes from one X-Forwarded-For address, asserts the first 12 advertise limit 12, and asserts the thirteenth returns 429 with matching positive Retry-After headers while another forwarded client remains allowed.

claim: The sample opens without an account or payment.
sandbox: A fresh browser opens the complete seeded demo and records that no login, checkout, or payment request occurs.

claim: Reset demo starts a fresh set of sample bookings.
sandbox: Fresh /demo workspace changes the recovery state, selects Reset demo, asserts a new token and original states, then proves the old workspace returns 404.

claim: A recovery message needs recorded contact consent.
sandbox: Demo data includes one unfinished attempt without email consent. Attempting recovery leaves no outbound message in its case and shows the consent explanation.

claim: The demo shows a receipt after a sample recovery action.
sandbox: Fresh demo selects the consented unfinished booking, runs the accelerated sample recovery, and asserts a timestamped simulated email receipt and case outcome are visible.

claim: Demo does not contact payment, messaging, sign-in, or AI services.
sandbox: Playwright records every request for the full fresh-demo flow and asserts each URL is same-origin; no request is made to Stripe, a messaging provider, Entra, Sociobot billing, or the AI gateway.
